analysis.session_summary: Overnight the tape was driven by the RBNZ's dovish hold: OCR remained 2.75% against a 3.00% consensus, sending NZD -1.391% on the release and making it the weakest major. AUD strength from a 0.8% vs 0.7% CPI beat ranked second, while JPY led with +0.294% on safe-haven demand; USD firmed +0.218% with DXY up +0.108. EUR/USD traded a news-light range to -14.7 pips, with no leg owning a clear catalyst. The main risk-relevant headline was a US warning of possible short, intense renewal of Iran war, adding to risk-off tone.

themes.evidence: OCR held at 2.75% vs 3.00% forecast; NZD own-ccy impulse -1.391%; NZD/USD -73.8 pips; AUD/NZD +169.0 pips.
CPI printed 0.8% vs 0.7% forecast; AUD own-ccy impulse +0.108%; AUD/CHF +11.9 pips.
JPY strength +0.294%, USD +0.218%, VIX +0.443%; US-Iran warning appeared across leg drivers.

currency_drivers.USD: No US data; firmed with risk-off headlines and higher DXY.
currency_drivers.EUR: No euro-area catalyst; early selling was rejected and price recovered most losses.
currency_drivers.JPY: No Japanese releases; safe-haven demand drove strongest major, closing at its best.
currency_drivers.GBP: No UK data; GBP lacked an independent driver and tracked broad USD moves.
currency_drivers.AUD: Australia CPI beat at 0.8% vs 0.7% forecast, adding to AUD strength.
currency_drivers.CAD: No Canadian data; CAD moved modestly with no clear domestic catalyst.
currency_drivers.CHF: No Swiss catalyst; CHF largely tracked the dollar block with little independent direction.
currency_drivers.NZD: RBNZ held OCR at 2.75% vs 3.00% forecast, a dovish miss that sank NZD.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD three legs: -10.8 pips to 21:45, +6.2 pips to 23:30, then -12.3 pips into the close; none had a clear catalyst, leaving it -14.7 pips at 1.11185.

polarity_reads.read: A normal -1.391% NZD impulse on a 25bp miss shows the market was positioned for RBNZ tightening; the dovish hold forced longs out.
Normal +0.108% AUD impulse on a 0.1pp beat signals inflation expectations were underpriced, sparking AUD demand.
Unscored because no forecast, but NZD fell another 0.220%, reinforcing the dovish interpretation.
Muted 0.030% basket move, inside the noise floor, confirms no new policy signal and no fresh AUD catalyst.

scenarios.name: Base: BOC 25bp, budget contained
scenarios.thesis: BOC delivers the 2.50% hike and balanced guidance; NZD consolidates after the RBNZ overshoot.
scenarios.invalidation: BOC hold or a hawkish surprise beyond 2.50%

pair_paths.rationale: BOC hike as forecast supports CAD; move capped by overnight range 27.2 pips.
NZD stabilizes inside overnight range 104.3 pips after the dovish shock.
Budget in line leaves GBP within overnight range 29.9 pips.

scenarios.name: Dovish BOC or budget shock
scenarios.thesis: BOC either holds or signals limited tightening, and/or the GBP budget disappoints, renewing risk-off and CAD/GBP underperformance.
scenarios.invalidation: A clean 25bp hike with hawkish guidance and strong budget credibility

pair_paths.rationale: Dovish BOC undermines CAD; USD/CAD tends toward 27.2 pip overnight range top.
Budget disappointment hits GBP; overnight range 29.9 pips provides the move envelope.
Risk-off extends post-RBNZ NZD weakness; overnight range 104.3 pips.

scenarios.name: Hawkish BOC / risk-on recovery
scenarios.thesis: BOC explicitly signals further tightening beyond 2.50% and geopolitical tensions ease; CAD and risk-sensitive FX recover, NZD shorts partly squeeze.
scenarios.invalidation: BOC hold or renewed geopolitical headline

pair_paths.rationale: Hawkish BOC boosts CAD; USD/CAD targets low end of 27.2 pip range.
Risk-on helps oversold NZD rebound, cooling AUD/NZD from its 255.1 pip range.
Risk-on reduces safe-haven JPY demand; USD/JPY retests 28.9 pip range.

risks.why_it_matters: Overnight Rate forecast 2.50% vs previous 2.25%; a hold or surprise beyond 2.50% can move CAD crosses sharply.
Fiscal surprise can hit GBP and gilt yields; no prior forecast to anchor expectations.
US-Iran headline already contributed to risk-off; renewed escalation would boost safe havens and hurt high-beta FX.
NZD is oversold after -1.391% OCR impulse; any positive NZD headline can trigger a sharp short squeeze.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: At 13:30 GBP Annual Budget/Autumn Forecast; at 14:45 BOC Overnight Rate expected 2.50% vs previous 2.25%, with press conference at 15:30. These can reprice GBP and CAD and shift broad risk.
